To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a rule-based fuzzy expert system can be used successfully to supervise biotechnical process control.
a rule-based, knowledge-based system for bioprocessing control can be designed and implemented in Smalltalk/Macintosh, and it can be successfully used to control a bioprocess on-line.
A rule-based knowledge system for supervisory control and fault diagnosis of bioprocess can be successfully applied to the biotechnical production process of lactic acid.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new approach to the design of real-time knowledge-based systems for supervisory control and fault diagnosis of bioprocess.
the development of a real-time knowledge based control system for bioprocessing.
the application of artificial intelligence techniques to the development of a knowledge-based system for supervisory control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this knowledge based system has proven to be an effective tool for the supervision and automatic control of biotechnical processes, especially when the process variables cannot be measured directly.
the system is able to supervise the process, detect the faults, give linguistic advice to the operator, and to generate control strategies for the automatic control system.
the knowledge based system described here is a useful tool to supervise bioprocesses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fuzzy expert system was able to supervise a biotechnical process and to generate on-line fault diagnostic information and advice to the operator.
the fuzzy knowledge-based system is a promising tool for supervisory control and fault diagnosis of bioprocess.

we have constructed and tested a knowledge based system for real-time supervision of bioprocess, which is able to detect and diagnose faults, and to give countermeasures to restore the process to its normal state.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fuzzy expert systems can be successfully used in biotechnical process supervision.
fuzzy expert systems can be used in the supervision of bioprocess control, and that fuzzy expert systems are suitable for real-time applications.
the use of fuzzy logic is a promising tool for bioprocess control and that the integration of a fuzzy expert system in the control loop of bioprocess can be successfully realized.
